import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

MOD = 10**9 + 7
E100 = 570000004
MAXN = 7

def main():
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    g = [[0]*n for _ in range(n)]
    idx = 1
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            g[i][j] = int(data[idx])
            idx += 1
            g[i][j] = g[i][j] * E100 % MOD

    bitcnt = [0]*(1<<n)
    for i in range(1, 1<<n):
        bitcnt[i] = bitcnt[i ^ (i & -i)] + 1

    S = [[] for _ in range(n+1)]
    id_map = [0]*(1<<n)
    for i in range(1<<n):
        id_map[i] = len(S[bitcnt[i]])
        S[bitcnt[i]].append(i)

    nxt = [[0]*(1<<n) for _ in range(1<<n)]
    for i in range(1<<n):
        for j in range(1<<n):
            for k in range(n):
                if (i & (1<<k)) and not (j & (1<<k)):
                    nxt[i][j] |= 1 << id_map[j | (1<<k)]

    from functools import lru_cache

    @lru_cache(None)
    def solve(i, msk):
        if msk == 0:
            return 0
        if i == n:
            return 1
        res = 0
        for s in range(1<<n):
            p = 1
            for j in range(n):
                if s & (1 << j):
                    p = g[i][j] * p % MOD
                else:
                    p = (1 - g[i][j]) * p % MOD
            nmsk = 0
            for j in range(35):
                if (1 << j) & msk:
                    nmsk |= nxt[s][S[i][j]]
            res += p * solve(i+1, nmsk)
            res %= MOD
        return res

    ans = solve(0, 1)
    ans = (ans % MOD + MOD) % MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
